clauses.quote: The determination of whether or not a vacancy or opening exists is within the sole discretion of the District.
clauses.subject_text: The determination of whether or not a vacancy or opening exists
clauses.notes: Confers discretionary authority to management over vacancy determinations.

clauses.quote: Unit members transferred, reassigned, or moved after the first day of instruction shall be provided with one day working with the person currently in the assignment or to prepare for the assignment.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members transferred, reassigned, or moved after the first day of instruction
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit actor is District/management.

clauses.quote: An additional day(s) may be granted upon request by the Associate Superintendent, Human Resource or designee.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit actor is management.

clauses.quote: A unit member who has applied for a transfer or reassignment to a specific vacancy or opening shall not, as a result of having filed for a transfer or reassignment, be removed from his/her current assignment until the transfer or reassignment has been decided.
clauses.subject_text: A unit member who has applied for a transfer or reassignment to a specific vacancy or opening
clauses.notes: Negated passive duty creates a right/relief from removal during pending transfer decisions.

clauses.quote: When a request for unit member-initiated reassignment or transfer is denied for reasons other than lack of a vacancy, District management shall, upon request, provide unsuccessful applicants with a statement of reasons for denial of their request for reassignment or transfer based on the criteria listed in this Article.

The initial assignments of support staff personnel (Psychologists, Speech/Language Specialists, Nurses, Adapted P.E. Teachers, Migrant Education Teachers, Curriculum Specialists, Itinerant Teachers, Child Welfare and Attendance Workers) to work sites shall be at the discretion of their respective departments.
clauses.subject_text: The initial assignments of support staff personnel (Psychologists, Speech/Language Specialists, Nurses, Adapted P.E. Teachers, Migrant Education Teachers, Curriculum Specialists, Itinerant Teachers, Child Welfare and Attendance Workers) to work sites
clauses.notes: Phrased as a duty on assignments but functionally grants management discretion.

clauses.quote: Changes in assignments shall be made after seeking volunteers as appropriate
clauses.notes: Procedural duty imposed on management regarding reassignment timing.

clauses.quote: and shall not be made arbitrarily or capriciously.
clauses.notes: Restricts management discretion; subject carried over from preceding clause.

clauses.quote: As openings occur at each site, they shall be made known to all unit members of the site.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit actor is management.

clauses.quote: Unit members off cycle, on summer recess or on leave of absence shall provide stamped, self-addressed envelopes if they want to be notified of openings.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members off cycle, on summer recess or on leave of absence
clauses.notes: Conditions worker participation in the transfer notification process.
